description: Use when you need a random number generator, dice rolls, a coin flip, a uuid or random bytes that no one can predict. Do not use for verifiable on-chain randomness (VRF) or reproducible seeded sequences. Returns JSON with cryptographically secure random values: integers in a range, dice rolls, coin flips, UUIDs or hex bytes, from the Workers Web Crypto CSPRNG for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 500 ms (p95). Category: Infrastructure.

count.description: How many values (1-100, default 1); ignored for bytes

kind.description: integer (count values between min and max), dice (count rolls of a die with sides faces), coin (count flips), uuid (count UUID v4) or bytes (length random bytes as hex)

length.description: bytes: how many random bytes (1-256, default 32)

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

name: blackwood_random_generate

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one
